featured.label: In-house product
featured.title: Quote & Lead Processing Flow
featured.description: The server-side flow behind Fillip's online quote builder and contact forms, turning website enquiries into stored, followed-up leads.
featured.challenge: Quote requests and enquiries needed to be validated, saved and followed up consistently, with an estimate sent to the visitor straight away.
featured.solution: Node.js route handlers that validate each request, calculate the quote, generate a PDF estimate, email it to the visitor and store the quote and lead in MongoDB.

Lead and quote storage in MongoDB

faqItems.question: How much does it cost to hire a Node.js developer?
faqItems.answer: The cost depends on the developer's experience, the complexity of your backend, the integrations involved, the engagement model and how long you need the developer. We provide a project-specific estimate once we understand your requirements.

faqItems.question: What type of Node.js developers can I hire?
faqItems.answer: You can hire Node.js Backend Developers, Node.js API Developers, Express Developers, NestJS Developers, Full-Stack Node.js Developers, Node.js Integration Developers, Node.js + TypeScript Developers and Node.js Database Developers.

faqItems.question: What technologies do your Node.js developers work with?
faqItems.answer: Our Node.js developers work with Node.js, TypeScript and JavaScript; frameworks such as Express, NestJS and Next.js; REST, GraphQL and webhooks; databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis; cloud and DevOps tools such as AWS, Google Cloud, Docker and CI/CD; and payment gateways such as Razorpay and Stripe.

faqItems.question: Can your Node.js developers build the backend for our mobile app?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Node.js developers can build the APIs, authentication, data storage and notifications your Android, iOS or cross-platform app needs, and work alongside your mobile developers.
